selection_rationale.reason: Include resilience for LLM path: brief mandates 'LLM routing, VAD/turn-taking, JSON-Schema tool calling for rubric scoring' — withResilience + DegradedResult prevents mid-demo failure disqualification.

Include platform for deployed walk-through: brief requires 'runs a realistic screening call, then returns an evidence-backed scorecard' at public URL — DEP/TRN/UI satisfies submission gate deploy check.

Exclude media: brief mandates AssemblyAI Voice Agent API Universal-3 Pro STT/ TTS via AssemblyAI wss, not generic media/stt via OPENAI_API_KEY/REPLICATE/ELEVENLABS — accepting risk of losing generic STT/TTS polish, not disqualification.

Include ideation: brief defines 'Realtime AI Mock-Interview Voice Coach on AssemblyAI' — pitching this concept requires populated deck, timed script, judge Q&A sheet, and captured demo — deckgen/script/faqdef/demodrive satisfy pitch verification and standing submission gate.
Include context for voice turn history: brief's 'single-connection Voice Agent API interviewer (Universal-3 Pro STT, LLM routing' requires provider-agnostic message buffer across interview turns.
Exclude dev-tooling: brief lists no requirement for mock/eval/doctor/track/bench harness — accepting risk of losing local eval polish, not Stage-One disqualification.
Exclude assembly-advisory: ASM/ADV rarely needed in working copy — brief does not mandate in-copy re-assembly; accepting risk of manual architecture verification only.
Exclude data: synthetic seeded transcript is dev-convenience (GOV-MIN-04) not Stage-One required — accepting risk of needing live mic, not disqualification.
Exclude cost: brief contains no credit/cost cap, budget limit, or 'track api costs' metering requirement — accepting risk of untracked credit burn mid-demo, not disqualification for this track.

Include provenance: brief promises 'evidence-backed scorecard quoting exact spoken moments' requiring disclosure of generated vs. spoken evidence — prov/submit satisfies disclosure doc + repo hygiene walk-through for standing submission gate.
pgm is pre-assembly market research only, never part of the delivered app (NONGOAL-12)
Exclude profile: already run pre-assembly, not part of delivered app — brief does not explicitly scope re-assembly inside working copy.
